teaching.title: Programming Tutor
bullets: Prepared practice questions on variables and conditionals for use during individual programming tutoring sessions.
Discussed debugging approaches during tutoring sessions and asked learners to explain the steps in their solutions.

teaching.title: Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Answered student questions during office hours and prepared worked examples on debugging, lists, and arrays for instructor review.
Graded programming exercises covering debugging, lists, and arrays using a rubric provided by the instructor.

projects.title: Study Planner Interface
bullets: Built a local browser interface with form inputs for a study planner using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Documented the study planner interface and the local data flow associated with its form inputs.

projects.title: Dependency Ordering
bullets: Used Python and Git for a dependency ordering project, implementing graph traversal and an ordering routine.
Tested the dependency ordering implementation against connected, disconnected, and cyclic examples in the course project.

projects.title: Truth-Table Explorer
bullets: Translated discrete mathematical definitions into Python functions for a truth-table explorer implementation.
Tested the implementation against hand-worked cases and explained connections between formal definitions and program functions.
